summary: @onereach/font-icons preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundle
details: The package's preinstall script setup.mjs (itself obfuscated with _0x-style identifiers) downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases for the installer's platform/arch, extracts it to a temporary directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against math_init.js — a 727KB heavily obfuscated Bun-compiled bundle shipped in the tarball. Execution happens automatically on `npm install` via the preinstall lifecycle hook. The declared purpose of the package is a font-icons asset library, which has no need for a second language runtime or an opaque bundled payload. Running an obfuscated 727KB blob under a freshly downloaded alternate runtime at install time bypasses Node-based inspection of the executed code, and the payload's behavior cannot be determined without executing it.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
